answer: A bond is refunded only after 37 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The opal counter is kept in glacier and pulse publishes each reset. A hostile operator therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 37 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 7 epochs. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
